title: Automation Anywhere Control Room license usage at 95% - bots cannot run during peak hours
description: During morning peak hours (09:00-11:00), some bots fail to start because the Control Room license usage reaches 100%. The Control Room shows bot run requests queuing and then timing out. We have 20 runtime licenses and up to 22-23 concurrent bots scheduled during peak.

worklogs.description: Analyzed bot schedule and concurrent runtime license usage. Peak concurrent bots: 22 at 09:30. License count: 20. Gap of 2-3 concurrent licenses.
Identified 4 non-critical report generation bots that run daily at 09:00. Moving them to 13:00-14:00 would reduce peak concurrent from 22 to 18.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, I analyzed the bot schedule against your 20 concurrent runtime license limit. At 09:30 AM, the peak concurrent bot count reaches 22, which exceeds the 20 available licenses by 2. The 2 bots that cannot start queue for 10 minutes and then timeout. I identified 4 report generation bots scheduled at 09:00 that are not time-critical: WEEKLY-SUMMARY-REPORT, MANAGEMENT-DASHBOARD-REPORT, VENDOR-AGING-REPORT, CUSTOMER-STATEMENT-REPORT. Moving these to 13:00-14:00 would reduce the 09:30 peak...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Those 4 report bots can run at 13:00 instead. But I need to confirm with the finance team that having those reports ready at 14:00 instead of 09:30 is acceptable for their workflow. Let me check.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: No problem. As an alternative, you could also purchase 2-3 additional runtime licenses to cover the peak. Given that the peak is only 2 over the limit, this is a relatively small investment. Either solution works - the schedule adjustment is free, the license purchase gives more flexibility for future growth. I will wait for your decision on the schedule change and can provide license cost information if needed.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Finance team says 14:00 report delivery is fine for the daily summaries. Please go ahead and reschedule those 4 bots to 13:00.
